title: Chronic Town
scene: Athens Georgia post-punk and American college-radio underground
notes: Ragged chiming guitars and murky vocals introduce a searching band unafraid of tape experiments.

title: Murmur
scene: Athens Georgia college rock; recorded at Reflection Sound Charlotte
notes: Hushed layered guitars and elusive singing reshape folk-rock and post-punk into atmospheric college rock.

title: Reckoning
scene: Athens Georgia college rock; Charlotte live-in-studio recording
notes: A faster live-band pulse pushes jangling hooks forward while slower songs retain emotional ambiguity.

title: Fables of the Reconstruction
scene: Athens Georgia alternative rock and Southern storytelling; recorded London
notes: London sessions turn Southern character studies into shadowy folk-rock with occasional strings and brass.

title: Lifes Rich Pageant
scene: Athens Georgia college rock; I.R.S. era American alternative rock
notes: Clearer vocals and forceful rhythm turn oblique jangle into politically charged anthems.

title: Document
scene: Athens Georgia college rock; politically outspoken American alternative rock
notes: Dark political songs fuse distorted guitars with polished arrangements and unexpected Fairlight textures.

title: Green
scene: American alternative rock; Warner Bros. major-label debut
notes: Mandolin pastoral songs and buoyant pop alternate with sharp protest rock and darker introspection.

title: Out of Time
scene: Early 1990s American alternative pop; acoustic and chamber arrangements
notes: Mandolin-led melodies and chamber arrangements embrace romantic ambiguity with playful pop detours.
